# ✅ Feature Acceptance Review

## Feature
- Name:
- Issue:
- Commit:
- Product owner:

## Acceptance criteria
| Criterion | Evidence | Result |
|---|---|---|

## Functional checks
- [ ] Main success path
- [ ] Empty and invalid input
- [ ] Error and fallback behavior
- [ ] Keyboard operation
- [ ] Clear/reset behavior

## Non-functional checks
- [ ] Accessibility
- [ ] Responsive layout
- [ ] Browser compatibility
- [ ] Performance measured where relevant
- [ ] Security/privacy reviewed

## Documentation and support
- [ ] README / guide updated
- [ ] Troubleshooting updated
- [ ] Release note prepared

## Decision
Accept / Reject / Needs changes, with owner and follow-up.
